topic: Momentum, Impulse, and Conservation of Momentum
key_concepts: Momentum is the product of mass and velocity
An object at rest has zero momentum
Greater mass or velocity results in greater momentum and makes an object harder to stop
Vehicle passenger capacity affects total mass and momentum
Impulse is the product of force and time
Braking force applied over time produces impulse that stops a vehicle
Total momentum before and after a collision is equal
Perfectly elastic and perfectly inelastic collisions produce different final velocities
A gun recoils with momentum equal and opposite to the bullet
Speed limits and proper firing posture relate to impulse and conservation of momentum
